title: Christmas
description: Christmas is celebrated on December 25th each year.

title: New Year's Day
description: New Year's Day is the first day of the year, celebrated on January 1st.

title: Halloween
description: Halloween is celebrated on October 31st with costumes and trick-or-treating.

title: Valentine's Day
description: Valentine's Day is celebrated on February 14th as a day of love and romance.

title: Independence Day
description: Independence Day celebrates the signing of the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776.

title: St. Patrick's Day
description: St. Patrick's Day is celebrated on March 17th to honor the patron saint of Ireland.

title: New Year's Eve
description: New Year's Eve is the last day of the year, celebrated on December 31st.

title: Thanksgiving
description: Thanksgiving is celebrated on the fourth Thursday of November in the United States.
